✦ THE WITCH'S ALMANAC ✦
from The Eldwyld Archives · eldwyld.com

Thank you for bringing this grimoire home.

WHAT'S IN THE BUNDLE
  · The-Witchs-Almanac-Letter.pdf  — US Letter (8.5 × 11 in)
  · The-Witchs-Almanac-A4.pdf      — A4 (210 × 297 mm)

PRINTING
  · Print single-sided at 100% scale ("actual size").
  · Every page is undated and reusable — print twelve month grids, or a fresh
    sabbat page each turning — the almanac never expires.
  · Ordinary paper works; 24 lb takes fountain pen beautifully, and
    cardstock makes a fine cover.

YOUR LICENSE
  Personal use: print as many copies as you wish, for yourself and for
  gifts, forever. Please don't resell or redistribute the files —
  send fellow travelers to the Archives instead.

A WORD OF CARE
  Nothing in these pages is medical advice. Forage with certainty:
  misidentification can be dangerous. Confirm every harvest with an
  up-to-date regional field guide.

Through code and creativity, we grow together.
